dataset.description:
The dataset contains event-based laser speckle imaging data (.raw format) of Saccharomyces cerevisiae colonies subjected to different metal ion treatments. From left to right, the columns represent colonies treated with distilled water (H₂O), ammonium dichromate ((NH₄)₂Cr₂O₇), copper sulfate (CuSO₄), nickel chloride (NiCl₂), and untreated control samples.

The top row corresponds to a salt concentration of 100 mM, while the bottom row represents a concentration of 1 M.

Each file contains time-resolved speckle patterns generated using a red 660 nm laser under controlled experimental conditions and is intended for the analysis of microbial activity and stress responses induced by metal ion exposure.

distribution.title:
The purpose of this dataset is to investigate the effects of different metal ion treatments and salt concentrations on the physiological activity and stress responses of Saccharomyces cerevisiae colonies using event-based laser speckle imaging.

By analyzing time-resolved speckle patterns generated by a 660 nm red laser, the data enable non-invasive monitoring of dynamic changes in microbial activity under controlled experimental conditions.

This dataset is intended to support quantitative assessment of cellular metabolism, viability, and stress-induced dynamics, as well as the development and validation of image-based and event-based analysis methods for microbial monitoring.

dataset.title: Event-Based Laser Speckle Imaging Dataset of Saccharomyces cerevisiae under Metal Ion Treatments

dmp.description:
The Data Management Plan (DMP) is developed in the framework of the Recovery and Resilience Facility project "Internal and External Consolidation of the University of Latvia" (No.5.2.1.1.i.0/2/24/I/CFLA/007), grant project “High throughput Laser speckle imaging to speed up experiments in microbiology”, No. BA-PA-2024/1-0072.

The dataset contains event-based laser speckle imaging data (.raw format) of Saccharomyces cerevisiae colonies subjected to different metal ion treatments. From left to right, the columns represent colonies treated with distilled water (H₂O), ammonium dichromate ((NH₄)₂Cr₂O₇), copper sulfate (CuSO₄), nickel chloride (NiCl₂), and untreated control samples.

The top row corresponds to a salt concentration of 100 mM, while the bottom row represents a concentration of 1 M.

Each file contains time-resolved speckle patterns recorded under controlled experimental conditions and is intended for the analysis of microbial activity and stress responses induced by metal ion exposure.

project.description: The project aims to develop and experimentally validate a non-contact label free optical technique for the early high-throughput assessment of microbial growth activity in solid media, utilising the physical phenomenon of variable laser speckle analysed through temporal image sequence processing. This evaluation process involves acquiring time-variable laser speckle patterns in multiwell plates and processing the obtained image sequences.
